notes.title: Sun City: Episode 2 in Full Production!🌴
notes.content:
[p]Dear Sun City players,[/p][p]Work on Episode 2 is in full swing! We're expanding the Sun City universe with new story arcs, scenes, and characters.[/p][p]This episode brings [b]higher-quality rendered scenes[/b], more detailed [b]character animations[/b], and [b]new lighting compositions[/b] compared to previous content. We're using upgraded techniques to push the visual quality even further.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/381fce11fa754129577f4b319d37a817beeb050d.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’re also excited to share that [b]new characters are joining the story[/b], bringing fresh relationships, new choices, and unexpected twists.[/p][p]The character featured in the image is just a glimpse of what’s coming in Episode 2. Sun City’s world of heat, mystery, and eroticism is getting deeper with every chapter.[/p][p]We're moving forward while carefully listening to your feedback. Stay tuned—much more is on the way very soon![/p][p]💛 Thanks for your support!
– The Sun City Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/ca6f59443a8f00a89875fc57e607661a93de946a.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Sun City Episode 2 – UPDATE NEWS
notes.content:
[p]With Episode 2, nothing in Sun City will ever be the same again. The story now follows a path of no return.[/p][p]Sun City isn’t just an adult-themed game—it aims to offer a powerful narrative and a truly immersive story experience. The support you showed in Episode 1 was beyond anything we could have imagined. Honestly, even we didn’t expect this much love. And that’s exactly why we’re raising the bar even higher now.[/p][p]With Episode 2, we're determined to create the best game in our category—pushing boundaries with every step. Each new chapter will elevate both the visual quality and the narrative depth, making the Sun City universe truly unforgettable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/8590757bb156ab831660635b162e6b0667f811e4.gif"][/img][/p][p]We recently shared a sneak peek of what’s coming in Episode 2. Don’t worry—we’ll keep you updated every step of the way.[/p][p]Here’s what’s waiting for you in Episode 2:[/p][p]💥 Brand-new locations (Nightclub, VIP Restaurant)
💥 All current areas in the game are getting revamped
💥 Enhanced animations and cinematic scenes
💥 Impactful choices that shape the story
💥 Status Points system is now active
💥 Both Relationship Points and Status Points will influence your decisions
💥 Your choices affect not just your relationships, but your social standing too
💥 Hidden areas and confrontations with the past begin here
💥 Exclusive character-driven storylines will be featured[/p][p]💥20 Original Soundtracks[/p][p]Sun City is now darker, deeper, and far more dangerous. Don’t forget us…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/c4b7e56693356c4e1468025f70f436419aae3d12.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Sun City: The Next‑Gen Character Update Is Coming!
notes.content:
[p][i][b]The Sun City universe continues to grow…[/b][/i]
And the upcoming update will elevate our characters to a whole new level![/p][p]💥 Expressions will be more natural, emotions deeper, and gazes far more meaningful.
Relationships won’t just be felt through words, but through facial expressions as well.[/p][p]The short preview below is just a glimpse of the new system. 👇[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/f55c0ed1f222351eb99c262805eb533c6028712b.gif"][/img][/p][p]These improvements are possible thanks to your feedback and the support you’ve shown the game. Our goal is to strengthen your connection to the story and turn Sun City into a living world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/1c782615bad9c57e7a0321e58f6178e1243357fb.gif"][/img][/p][p]🗣️ Character voice‑overs, gestures, and animations are now more realistic and fine‑tuned for a seamless, immersive experience.
With Episode 2 — and this major update covering Episode 1 — not only will new episodes get upgraded, [b]but Episode 1 will receive a whole new experience too[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Completely revamped voice acting[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Lively facial animations[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced scene transitions[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]🎉 Thank you for your support as this universe continues to grow every day.[/p][p][b]Stay tuned — the real story is just beginning.[/b] 🌆[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/6d11dcc6f6895b79f5be324c8f108d4bc2ef704e.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 💬 Help Us Shape Episode 2
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!
Episode 1 is out and we’re so grateful for your support. 💜
We're already laying the groundwork for Episode 2 — and [b]your feedback means everything[/b].[/p][p]✅ What did you like?
🛠️ What would you improve?
💡 What would you love to see next?[/p][p]Drop a comment, leave a review, or just send a vibe. Your voice really matters.[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of Sun City’s journey. 🌆[/p]

notes.title: Thank You for an Amazing Launch! ❤️
notes.content: [p][b]Sun City had an amazing launch day — and we’re beyond grateful for all the love and support.[/b][/p][p]Thousands of players from around the world jumped into Chapter 1, and the feedback has been overwhelming in the best way possible.[/p][p]We’ve read your comments, reviews, and messages — and we’re truly humbled.[/p][p]As a small indie team, we take every word seriously. We’re actively working on:[/p][p][b][i]Chapter 2[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]Improved translations[/i][/b] (Spanish, Russian, French, etc.)[/p][p][b][i]Requested features like gallery, achievements, and UI polish[/i][/b][/p][p]This is just the beginning.[/p][p]We built Sun City to be a slow-burning, story-driven experience — and we’re excited to keep growing it with your support.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of the journey.[/p][p]❤️ FF DIGITAL[/p]

notes.title: 💋 Sun City – Episode 1 Released
notes.content: [p][i][b]The wait is over. 🌆[/b][/i][/p][p]**Sun City – Episode 1 is finally live.**[/p][p]After a heartbreaking tragedy, your journey leads you to a new city — and a new life filled with secrets, seduction, and second chances.[/p][p]🌹 A story-driven adult experience  [/p][p]🎭 Rich characters & emotional backstories  [/p][p]🎮 Dialogue choices that shape your path  [/p][p]🔥 Romance, drama... and more[/p][p]Leave the demo behind.  [/p][p]Step into the full story — your decisions matter now.[/p][p]---[/p][p]We’re just getting started — and we’re incredibly thankful to have you on this journey. 💜[/p][p][b]💬 Your support in this very first episode is *crucial*.[/b]  [/p][p]It directly helps us deliver the next chapters faster, better, and with even more depth.[/p][p]Share your thoughts, feedback, or bug reports —  [/p][p]**your voice truly helps shape the future of Sun City.**[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45008918/b99e6f641fb1f5f95222aa8950223c48a3bba8d3.jpg"][/img][/p]
